description: A narration of any length from plain text, spoken in one cloned voice and joined without audible seams. Audio8-TTS holds about 95 s of reference, text and speech together (see 'voice-clone'), so the text is cut into takes at sentence boundaries by the 'split_takes' task (60 s a take by default, 2.5 words a second, so a take is about 150 words), and a child workflow, 'narration-from-takes', speaks each take under one 'reference_audio', 'reference_text' and 'seed' and joins them in order: the child expands its own 'for_each' over the takes it is handed. 'gap_seconds' of silence follows each take (0.3 by default, a first guess to be tuned by ear) and 'crossfade_ms' (30) is the overlap at every join; see 'narration-from-takes' for how the gap and the crossfade combine. Abbreviations such as Dr. and initials are not sentence ends. The same seed does not make takes sound alike by itself, so listen for a voice that drifts between takes and use a lower 'max_seconds' if one does; check the joined file's loudness before relying on it. Consent: clone only a voice you have the right to use - your own, or one whose owner has agreed - and never to impersonate or deceive. There is no default voice: 'reference_audio' (an asset: reference, at most 20 s) and 'reference_text' (exactly what is said in it) are required together, as in 'voice-clone'.

variables.text: Somebody finished the pistachio and nobody is saying anything. The fridge hums, and nobody looks up from their phone. It was a quiet kind of guilt.
variables.reference_text: The words spoken in the reference clip, exactly as said.

summary: A narration from plain text, cut into takes and spoken in one cloned voice.
